title: StructuredFields
description: Decomposed prompt structure - the system's core contribution, distinct from a raw tag blob.

subject.description: The primary subject(s) of the prompt, e.g. 'a red fox in a snowy forest'.

lighting.description: Lighting descriptor, e.g. 'golden hour', 'studio lighting', 'volumetric fog'.

modifiers.description: Free-form quality/detail modifiers, e.g. ['highly detailed', '8k', 'trending on artstation'].

negative_constraints.description: Things the prompt implies should be avoided (from negative prompts or inferred exclusions).
